title: CogBattery: Human-Referenced Evaluation of Cognitive Task Behavior and Structure in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.24999v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Human cognitive tasks let us compare language models with humans under controlled conditions. Yet a model can reproduce the direction of a human effect while making different errors. CogBattery evaluates 54 open-weight language models on text adaptations of 13 cognitive paradigms, comparing each with human data from its source study. Like humans, models respond more to n-back lures than to controls, yet they make far more false alarms on ordinary non-targets. Most models' reported confidence separates correct from incorrect answers less well than humans' does, and most always choose the same wager, including models that classify accurately. These patterns span many model families. Across tasks, model scores share two dimensions. The first is closely tied to scale, yet larger models are not consistently closer to humans. Predefined cognitive groupings show no reliable predictive advantage over random groupings of the same size. These

translated_title: CogBattery：语言模型认知任务行为与结构的人类参照评估
translated_abstract: 人类认知任务使我们能够在受控条件下将语言模型与人类进行比较。然而，模型可以在复现人类效应方向的同时犯下不同的错误。CogBattery 在13个认知范式的文本改编版本上评估了54个开源权重语言模型，并将每个模型与其来源研究的人类数据进行比较。与人类类似，模型对n-back任务中的诱饵刺激的反应强于对照刺激，但它们在普通非目标项上产生的错误警报却远多于人类。大多数模型所报告的置信度在区分正确与错误答案方面不如人类有效，而且大多数模型总是选择相同的赌注，其中包括那些分类准确的模型。这些模式跨越了许多模型家族普遍存在。纵观各任务，模型得分共享两个维度。第一个维度与模型规模密切相关，然而更大的模型并不总是更接近人类。预定义的认知分组相较于相同规模的随机分组并未表现出可靠的预测优势。
tldr: CogBattery通过13个认知范式将54个开源语言模型与人类数据进行对比评估，发现模型虽能复现人类效应的方向，但在错误模式、元认知置信度等方面与人类存在系统性差异，且更大规模的模型并不必然更接近人类认知表现。
en_tdlr: CogBattery benchmarks 54 open-weight language models against human data across 13 cognitive paradigms, revealing that models replicate the direction of human effects but differ systematically in error patterns and metacognitive confidence, and that larger models are not consistently more human-like.
